notes: The protasis writes כִּי, so the ASV's *If* is that morpheme's and nothing is added (rule 55); the apodosis writes its own waw, which takes the *then* (rule 14).
Unlike vv. 9–11, no subject pronoun is written for the suffix of לוֹ — the subject carries over from *a man* — so that suffix is unrepresented under rule 22 while לְ still takes the *have* (rule 43).
